why_on_radar.ringkasan:
Asentum is a post-quantum Layer-1 blockchain engineered to withstand the coming quantum computing era while democratizing smart contract development. Built with NIST FIPS 204 ML-DSA-65 (Dilithium3) signatures from genesis, Asentum is the first major chain cryptographically secured against quantum attacks. Its JavaScript-native smart contract environment opens blockchain development to 22+ million existing developers, eliminating language barriers that have constrained the industry. 

Running on Tendermint-style BFT consensus optimized for consumer hardware, Asentum enables permissionless validation on devices as modest as a Raspberry Pi 4, fundamentally redistributing network power. ASE powers transaction fees, validator staking, governance participation, and ecosystem incentives, anchoring an infrastructure built to outlast legacy chains facing quantum obsolescence.
